name: Advanced Baseline Imager Level 2 - Legacy Vertical Temperature Profile
description: Retrieves the vertical profile of atmospheric air temperature at 101 pressure levels using ABI infrared channels and background model fields. Together with the moisture profile from ABI-L2-LVMP, it provides a full thermodynamic sounding for each ABI pixel.

LVT.description: ABI L2+ Legacy Vertical Temperature Profile provides air temperature at 101 pressure levels in the atmosphere
